description: Extensible local catalog of public-domain cello scores (IMSLP/Mutopia/CC0 MusicXML). Bach Prelude + Gabrielli Ricercari are first test entries — add any PD MusicXML with scripts/add_catalog_piece.py. On MATCH the primary .musicxml is a verbatim copy of the edition file (slurs/trills preserved). Unknown pieces fall back to audio transcription.

entries.title: Bach Cello Suite No. 1, BWV 1007 — Prélude
entries.match_notes: Fingerprint extracted from the edition MusicXML (monophonic pitch sequence). Slurs/trills preserved in the verbatim edition file.

entries.title: Gabrielli Ricercari for Solo Cello (G minor)
entries.edition: WIMA/IMSLP-aligned catalog MusicXML (swap in Amaracle CC0 MXL #923358 via add_catalog_piece.py)
entries.match_notes: Fingerprint currently audio-aligned to data/multi_note_phrases/gabrielli.wav for demo matching. After dropping the IMSLP CC0 MXL, re-run add_catalog_piece.py so fingerprint comes from the edition file.
